tasks.label: PyInstaller Linux
tasks.command: docker compose exec api pyinstaller --noconfirm /app/api.spec && docker cp api:/app/dist backend/dist/
tasks.detail: Build the backend using PyInstaller inside the Docker container

tasks.label: PyInstaller
tasks.detail: Build the backend using PyInstaller for the local platform

tasks.label: Build Full Application
tasks.detail: Build both backend and frontend, and package it up

tasks.label: Start Backend
tasks.command: cd backend && source ./venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && alembic upgrade head && uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8833 --log-level debug --access-log

tasks.label: Start Frontend
tasks.command: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && nginx -p "$PWD" -c ./nginx.conf

tasks.label: Tag and Release
tasks.command: VERSION=$(node -p "require('./frontend/package.json').version") && git tag v$VERSION && git push origin v$VERSION
tasks.detail: Create a version tag from package.json and push to trigger CI release
